description: Benign-difference case. The candidate is a real capture whose cart-actuator damping is 0.2% higher, which produces a real, measurable numerical difference in every trajectory. The difference is inside the declared engineering contract, so the correct answer is PASS with the difference reported rather than a failure. This is the case that distinguishes a validation framework from a difference detector: a tool that fails here is useless, because every real change produces some difference.
